scope: Mechanism tests reported in the manuscript; no licensed text or row-level output is included.

text_construction.mask_order: mask capped qa_doc bytes before passage chunking
text_construction.chunk_whitespace_rule: split masked document by whitespace and join words within each passage

model.name: llmware/industry-bert-sec-v0.1
model.call_pooling: equal passage mean followed by L2 normalization

global_alias_sources: canonical, original, and source company labels in the clean-room call table
canonical, original, source, query, and stable issuer symbol labels in the clean-room call table
historical company Name values in the dated metadata registry
historical ticker Symbol values in the dated metadata registry
full_pipeline_identity_mask.opening_claim_gate: retain an opening-derived issuer alias only when corroborated by the historical registry or the call's own company/ticker aliases
full_pipeline_identity_mask.short_ticker_rule: one- and two-character tickers are replaced only in an explicit ticker, symbol, or exchange context
full_pipeline_identity_mask.plain_single_company_rule: ordinary-word-shaped one-token issuer aliases are matched case-sensitively
full_pipeline_identity_mask.qualification: Automated broad named-entity masking is a stress test, not a gold-annotated guarantee that every brand or product reference is removed. Byte-identical reconstruction also requires the frozen licensed alias registries and capped source text.

same_identity_shell_body_swap.body_preprocessing: the frozen identity mask used by the full-pipeline control
same_identity_shell_body_swap.correct_arm: target identity shell plus target scrubbed Q&A body
same_identity_shell_body_swap.donor_arm: the byte-identical target identity shell plus a scrubbed same-month cross-sector donor body
same_identity_shell_body_swap.donor_matching_algorithm: one-to-one Hungarian assignment minimizing absolute log1p capped-Q&A-word-count distance
